message.reasoning: I'm thinking through a Monopoly strategy where jail is actually a safe position. Rolling doubles to escape costs nothing but forces me to move and risk landing on expensive properties, whereas staying put is free. The trade-off is between the safety of jail versus the forced movement if I succeed at rolling doubles, though I've been rolling anyway so I'm leaning toward just attempting it.
